reported_error: Native worker state is unavailable; active work was preserved.
root_cause: Stale cached worker identity caused unnecessary reloads; a retry during the existing cold load attempted an idle-state check before the native status API was available.
fix: Reconcile the requested model with the verified owned worker before deciding to switch.
Wait for the same verified loading invocation after a client disconnect instead of restarting it.
Require the expected native unit, recognized executable and matching invocation when detecting ownership.
scope: Live verification covers chat completions in streaming and non-streaming modes; cold-load disconnect, timeout, switching and ownership races are covered by isolated CPU regressions.
